animation.controlUnits: normalized inputs; sample clips by absolute time, do not blend unrelated controls
animation.clipSampling: Map normalized state over earliest to latest keyed times, not 0 to clip.duration; authored frame-1 keys can start at 1/30 second
animation.wingControlComposition: Apply full-endpoint linear morph flex then rotate around flexed hinge endpoints. Supplied adapter composes this after sampling TRS.
animation.gearInput: gear=0 deployed, gear=1 retracted; legacy physics.gearTransit is the opposite

wingFlex.rule: Set Up OR Down per side; reset opposite key. Drive ALL tagged meshes on that side, including accessories.
wingFlex.amplitudePolicy: Expressive game deformation, twice the 0.8 profile; not a real structural-load or damage limit
wingFlex.covePolicy: Endpoint-only clearance relief is baked into fixed-wing morphs; do not apply it to articulated hinge points

flightLife.physicsPolicy: Visual-only child transform. Host owns plane.group position/rotation/scale; no physics forces are applied
flightLife.composition: Sample independent clips; add bounded wing gusts; solve bent control hinges; clamp travel; apply pinned hose morphs; solve steering rods
flightLife.determinism: Analytic multi-frequency sine signals, no random-per-frame noise or accumulated transform offsets

kinematics.combinedControlRule: Solve tagged link_root_node/link_end_node segments after mixing gear and steering clips; centre steering during first 18% of retraction.
kinematics.retractionRig: ordinary glTF object transforms; baked clips, no Python runtime required
kinematics.hydraulics: fixed wing bearing, swivelling fixed-length cylinder, solved telescoping rod
kinematics.limitation: Reference-guided game kinematics, not certified engineering dimensions.

landingGear.note: Baked inward main-gear and forward tailwheel travel, independent wheel rotation and tail steering; real enclosed bays and sequenced doors.

exhaust.interiors: Closed blind cavities, not uncapped holes.

materials: Packed basecolor, ORM, normal PNG maps; no external texture dependencies.

cockpitRim.construction: Continuous explicit recess edge loops, supported aft edge flow and differential hull normals; final-skin-fitted bevelled sills with integral 8mm seal; sharp glass thickness rims
cockpitRim.motion: Hood crown and 75mm lift/440mm aft-slide geometry unchanged; sampled over actual clip key interval
cockpitRim.metadataCoordinates: Opening boundary and seal path metadata use unwarped source axes; authoring vertex indices predate bay booleans

surfaceDetail.scope: Separate rolled aluminum, silver lacquer, doped fabric, cast metal, wiped oleos, heat/soot exhaust, rubber and clear glazing; localized service wear
surfaceDetail.normalPolicy: No subtexel normal grain or periodic sheet ripples. Shallow resolved seams, rivets and local scratches only; mesh normals and silhouette unchanged
surfaceDetail.approximation: Authored game surface detail, not factory-exact rivet spacing or service-panel tooling

flightControlDetails.construction: Closed fitted hinge-nose collars, pin caps, flush service fittings and trim-setting hardware integrated into seven parent control meshes
flightControlDetails.finish: Riveted metal flaps/ailerons/later-D elevators; shallow fabric rib tapes on rudder; flush neutral trim demarcations
flightControlDetails.animation: Seven control owners and 11 portable clips retained; all wing-control detail follows stronger profile-v2 bend morphs
flightControlDetails.trimLimitation: Trim tabs are fixed-setting surface/hardware detail, following their parent control; no independent trim command in this revision

paintProjection.fuselage: Physical side-view projection using the varying superellipse section and final aft datum
paintProjection.uvLayout: Bilateral physical-Y atlas; linear projection through triangles, no cylindrical interpolation kink
paintProjection.paintEdges: Large insignia: two-texel pigment guard. Small stencils: area-sampled coverage with correlated paint/metal blend, no expanded outline or embossed relief

livery: Fictional period-inspired silver / blue / olive; not a claimed historical serial reproduction.
limitations: No detailed cockpit furnishings or physical suspension simulation
